note: A supersession records that a case's written expectation was made under an earlier rule set and that a later, deliberate rule change makes a different outcome correct. The expectation itself is never edited. Written before results-attempt5 was read.

rules.v3: until 2026-11-09: an uncorroborated identity claim fires the identity vow (REVIEW at any age)
rules.v4: from 2026-11-09/11: identity neutrality (an uncorroborated claim is the same as no claim; only a claim contradicted by an operator label BLOCKs) and kinship threshold v2

B4.why: Being examined must never be a penalty: an unverified seller name now scores the same as no name, so the identity vow no longer fires. The band stays REVIEW, by score.
